name: Fish Monster
source:
A Fish Monster that is seen roaming the mansion on subsequent playthroughs.

[spoiler][url=/c135885]Nami[/url] and [url=/c135899]Naomi[/url]'s younger brother.

In most endings, Naoki and the Fish Monster don't exist at all.
In the Delusional Ending, Naoki is a figment of Naomi's delusion.
In the Shadows Ending, Naoki died in a car accident alongside their father. A Fish Monster is conjured by Nami's shadow.
In the Fish Monster Ending and Monster Family Route, Naoki is transformed into a Fish Monster. He is either trying to eat Nami, or participate in their father's ceremony.
In the Fireflies Ending, the Fish Monster is a transformed Naomi.
In the Epilogues, it reveals the Fish Monster was just Naoki in disguise.[/spoiler]
